criterion_bindings.exemption: Backup mechanics are not scenario-observable. The guarantee is proved by TestBackupUsesOnlineSnapshotAndPM10Manifest (internal/store/backup_test.go) and TestBackupAndRestoreRoundTripViaCLI (cmd/concord/main_test.go).
Interrupted-backup behavior is an operation property. The guarantee is proved by TestInterruptedBackupRemovesPartialSnapshotAndManifest (internal/store/backup_test.go).
FK-only corruption detection is a verification property. The guarantee is proved by TestBackupRejectsForeignKeyOnlyCorruption (internal/store/backup_test.go).

Snapshot qualification refusal and rollback ordering are operation properties. TestBackupRefusesUnreplayableLogAndDiscardsSnapshot (internal/store/backup_test.go), TestHistoricalPayloadUpgradeSnapshotQualification and TestHistoricalPayloadRepairSnapshotQualification (cmd/concord/historical_backup_cli_test.go) prove refusal before manifest promotion or guarded mutation, until the CD-0242 cutover replaces replay-based qualification.

Restore staging and promotion is an operation property. The guarantee is proved by TestRestoreBackupUsesCleanOnlineRestoreAndPromotesVerifiedDatabase, TestRestoreBackupRefusesExistingDestinationUntouched, and TestInterruptedRestoreRemovesStagingAndLeavesDestinationAbsent (internal/store/backup_test.go).
Tamper and schema-direction rejection is a verification property. The guarantee is proved by TestBackupVerifyTamperAndOlderSchemaRejection (internal/store/fence_test.go).

summary: Defines backup and restore through the SQLite online backup interface with integrity, foreign-key, and quick verification.
